Drop: {drop:,} ({pct:.1f}%)' labels.append(name) parents.append('All Flags') values.append(max(val, 0)) texts.append(note) prev = val values[0] = sum(values[1:]) fig = go.Figure(go.Treemap( labels=labels, parents=parents, values=values, text=texts, textinfo='label+text', branchvalues='total', marker=dict(colorscale='Blues', colors=values, line=dict(width=2)) )) fig.update_layout(title='Flag Funnel: Rule Engine to ML Score to Manual Review (drop-off per stage)') print(fig.to_json())
